title_zh: 小区智能快递柜取件（取件码过期）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, do you know how this locker works? My pickup code keeps saying it’s expired.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. Have you tried requesting a new code in the app?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I did, but the door still won’t open.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sometimes you need to tap “Open again” within two minutes. Want me to show you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That would be great. Thanks so much.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No problem. Just tap here… There you go.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Perfect! I was worried I’d have to pick it up from the collection point tomorrow.

expressions.zh: 礼貌地接受别人的帮助/提议。
非正式口语：答应帮忙，或回应别人的感谢。
去某处取/领（包裹、预订的东西等）。
把东西递给对方、或帮对方弄好时的口语。
